invariants.rationale: The method immediately accesses the 'style' field, so it must be non-null at the entry point.
The return value is either 'style.disabledKnobBefore' if 'disabled' is true and it is not null, or 'style.knobBefore'. At least one will be returned, so this must hold.
If 'disabled' is true, 'style.disabledKnobBefore' must be non-null for control-flow to return that value.
